blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Luxury magazine Condé Nast Traveller (CNT) has named Coron, El Nido, and Boracay among the top 15 beaches in the world, the only country to get three spots on the list. Based on the 2026 CNT Readers’ Choice Awards, Coron ranked fourth with a score of 93.32; Boracay, eighth with 91.49; and El Nido, 10th with 91.27.
